title: Jev agent skill pack published for independent adoption
summary: Jev Agent Skills v1.3.0 is public under MIT with examples and offline tests; Skills Hub pins its source and the Library selects both exact releases in V42.
intent: Let other agent users install and fork the Jev pack from a shareable public repository and discover it through SISO Skills Hub and the Great Library.
reasoning: Independent adoption is an explicit promotion trigger; the public repository owns this coherent skill pack and its release lifecycle.
Only reviewed Jev source, examples and tests were published; local keys, receipts and unrelated unpublished Hub work remain outside the public release.
The pack keeps model judgments advisory, browser execution bounded and context evaluation in shadow mode. Publication does not claim production savings or configure other agents.

changes.summary: First standalone MIT release with 51 offline tests and install examples.
Pinned Jev entry, source snapshot and explicit promoted-repository catalog state.
Independent Work identity and reading page with source and usage links.
Adds the Jev release and updates only the selected Skills Hub release.

evidence.summary: 51 offline tests passed in public GitHub CI. A fresh clone of v1.3.0 passed the same suite and dry-run examples without API calls.
The merged catalog entry pins the reviewed full commit. Source snapshot and disposable installation matched all 21 public tracked files.
Work and release inputs passed the existing gls registration workflow and full Library gate.

next_actions: Measure real task quality, fallbacks and total cost before claiming production efficiency gains.
